reflection.proof: Exact block partition and modular interval identities cover all local labels; no vertex sampling is used.

phase_geometry.proof: For every class pair Arb proves |sin((phi_i-phi_j)/2)|>0 over the complete root box.

quotient.normalization: mass-orthonormal class quotient divided by N
quotient.zero_count_argument: The class-constant rotation vector is an exact zero by pairwise biregular cancellation. Arb LDL proves the rank-one-lifted even block and odd block exceed a strictly positive rational threshold.

transverse.decomposition: R^N is the six-dimensional class quotient direct-sum the six classwise zero-sum spaces.
transverse.operator_comparison_argument: Complete blocks annihilate classwise zero-sum vectors. For each residue block, the nonconstant-character norm is bounded uniformly by min(k,g-k,csc(pi/g)); Arb LDL proves the resulting scalar block comparison positive.

nonlinear.model: Exact six-class equitable Kuramoto flow integrated in scaled time s=lambda_min*t and scaled displacement u/amplitude with high-precision L-stable implicit steps.
